in_sanskrit.name: Ayodhyaansh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Born in Ayodhya
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ayodhyaansh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from 'Ayodhya', the birthplace of Lord Rama, this name signifies the divine connection and strength of the city. Ayodhyaansh is a name for a brave and virtuous boy, destined for greatness.
